fontScaleFix.cause: React Native 0.81.5 ships enableFontScaleChangesUpdatingLayout=false, the activity is recreated on fontScale changes, and Fabric only reads the font scale when the root view is re-measured.
fix: plugins/withFontScaleLayout.js enables enableFontScaleChangesUpdatingLayout, keeping every other Stable flag
MainActivity.onConfigurationChanged requests a root re-layout, then emits didUpdateDimensions to JS after that layout pass
App.tsx remounts the navigation tree on a fontScale change, preserving navigation state, so hidden tabs re-measure
fontScaleFix.revisit: Re-check on any React Native upgrade; the flag API is internal.
